$ rea mcp add --help
exit: 0
--- stdout
rea mcp add — Register exact stdio launcher arguments in selected client settings, with backups and verified publication.

Usage: rea mcp add [options]

Options:
  --agent <array>         Select client IDs or documented aliases; repeat --agent to select more than one.
  --command, -c <string>  Stdio launcher text: space-separated words, single/double quote fragments, literal backslashes. Empty quoted arguments are preserved; NUL is rejected. HTTP(S) URL sources are unsupported; configure remote transports in client settings.
  --no-global             Write only project-scoped client settings; reject selections requiring global writes.

No package acquisition or server execution. --no-global never writes global settings.

Global Options:
  --filter-output <keys>              Filter output by key paths (e.g. foo,bar.baz,a[0,3])
  --format <toon|json|yaml|md|jsonl>  Output format
  --full-output                       Show full output envelope
  --help                              Show help
  --json                              Shorthand for --format json
  --llms, --llms-full                 Print LLM-readable manifest
  --schema                            Show JSON Schema for command
  --token-count                       Print token count of output (instead of output)
  --token-limit <n>                   Limit output to n tokens
  --token-offset <n>                  Skip first n tokens of output
<end>
--- stderr
<end>
